entry_points.text: Super ops bind alloc, free, drop, evict, statfs and option show; file ops bind seek, read, write, poll, ioctl, mmap, unmapped-area, open and release with iterated read plus splice variants and compat ioctl; links bind only resolution; net, sysctl and tty initializers are inert stubs.

Kcore is permanent with iterated read, open, release and seek; startup registers text, vmalloc, optional modules when differing, plus ram, then subscribes to hotplug for refresh on online and offline with active and empty build variants; release frees per-file buffer.

Kmsg is permanent delegating to syslog with would-block and log-queue poll; loadavg and meminfo are permanent single-shot shows; count, flag and group delegate to shared scan; boot installs maps, owner-readable page views with group under memcg, and self-net alias.
Per-task net lookup, getattr and readdir delegate to the task anchor, missing on lookup without context, invalid on listing without context, link count overridden only when present.

exports.text: Generic proc write needs a handler or EACCES, accepts only non-empty sub-page sizes or EINVAL, copies with termination, delegates, frees, propagates failures and maps zero to length; permanent marker is null-tolerant.
One ram predicate may register or busy; absent means true; kcore append stores address, length and kind; arch meminfo hook is weak, silent by default and runs last.

Per-net seq or single entries carry show, state size and optional write under a parent; per-net mkdir adds a child dir; sysctl poll notify bumps events and wakes waiters if present; seq path appends with escaping; stable flags map snapshot or hole.

hazards.text: Absent handlers must not be called: EIO for data and mapping, default mask for poll, ENOTTY for ioctls, arch fallback or original address for unmapped area; write needs handler or EACCES and non-empty sub-page size or EINVAL.

Kcore data gives zeros when unmapped; vmalloc uses safe iterator with retry, user direct copy, ram zeros when absent, offline, poisoned, excluded or unaccepted else device translation, others use bounce with zero fill, unknown kinds log once as zeros; offline freeze holds read access with periodic thaw, always released.

First process entry is 256, numeric buffer 13, core flags zero, unload bias most-negative 32-bit; stride is u64 width with mask stride-minus-one and selector for flags, count and group; virtual address and kcore offset convert via direct-map base with direct-map device translation and no-op inverse.

invariants.text: Caches for inodes, openers and dentries use accounting, reclaim and name usercopy with panic on failure; alloc neutralizes pid, descriptor, link, entry, sysctl and ns fields; free drops pid and entry refs; evict drops cache, clears, detaches pid and sysctl header then sysctl cleanup.
Hide values map to distinct tokens with warning and fallback; options emit only when non-default for group, hide mode and pid-only subset.

Seek, read, iterated read, write, mmap, unmapped-area, poll and both ioctls use permanent-direct versus counted dispatch; counted pin failure gives EINVAL for seek and EIO-like defaults otherwise, default poll mask or ENOTTY when handlerless.

Interrupts iterate by position bounded by live count with unit step, no cleanup, in seq ops installed early; nommu regions show rwx letters, sharing class, zero dev and inode without file else dev, inode, page-offset-derived offset and path.

Kcore size starts at one note header, extends over segment ends with one program header each, fixed lengths, page-aligned data start, published root size and pending flag; ram check delegates or true; inventory builds low or node-scanned descriptors with overflow and vmalloc trimming.

Loadavg shows averages, running, threads and pid cursor; meminfo prints kilobytes with core rows always and conditional rows; page scan needs stride alignment, clamps, zeroes holes and offline, faults on copy failure; dump bound rounds under sparsemem; count is precise or average; bit copy relocates one flag.
Net lookup follows parent data with caller-owned ref.

locks.text: Sysctl count and linkage mutate under sysctl lock as one section; pin refuses unregistering else incs, last unpin of unregistering completes waiter with lock held; finish tolerates null; lookup and walk skip unregistering, return only pinned entries and release prior before next.

Opener insert and lookup with completion hold the unload lock; open pins or ENOENT, allocates opener only with release handler or ENOMEM with balanced unpin; ns follow and readlink resolve task, take killable exec read side, check read access, then jump or copy, always unlocking and dropping task.

Kcore uses one percpu rw control with write for refresh and read for full read plus inode mutex and coalesced flag; refresh stages then commits or discards, freeing old nodes outside lock; stream emits core header, per-range rwx headers and four padded notes; open checks lockdown and privilege with bounce buffer.

Region read side is held from start through stepping to stop; task net samples proxy under rcu plus task lock, nulled in pid-only mode without admin rights; net ref is owned by seq or single private state, needs minimum size and write handler for write mode, released exactly once with tracker-aware put.

state_machines.text: Non-permanent usage incs on entry and decs on exit, completing unload at a large negative bias, with link put as release and balanced cleanup on open failure.

Kcore refresh goes staging to commit to reclaim with re-arm on failure; region listing uses linear skip then show and step to stop; page scan loops translate, copy, advance and reschedule; per-net state goes absent to ready when anchor with link two, length three and stat child links, back when removed and freed.

structs.text: Dir entry holds usage and ref counts, opener list with lock and completion, inode ops, file-versus-dir ops, seq-versus-single show, write handler, data, state, inum, nlink, ownership, size, parent, subtree nodes, name, mode, flags and inline tail; size tiers define inline capacity.

Proc inode wraps pid, descriptor, link-versus-display-versus-lsm union, entry, sysctl header and entry, sibling node, ns ops and embedded VFS inode; opener links with file, closing flag and completion.

Tracked ranges carry address, length, kind and linkage with static vmalloc, text and modules spans; nommu seq maps start, next, stop and show to region handlers; count, flag and group tables mark permanent and bind memory seek with their readers.

Namespace table has mount always present, link inodes bind readlink, follow and chmod-refusing setattr, instantiate makes world links, dir emits dots then walk; sysctl mount is terminator-only and root is one empty-name dir; net seq and single bind net-aware open, seq read and write with net-aware release, per-task tables bind lookup, getattr and iteration with setup and teardown.
